protocol.evaluation: Six-case development smoke; no GT accuracy claim; model loading excluded.

method: Six selected public development cases, numbered by 1-based position in the 20-case source. Only current narrative/comments and imported service/work type enter TicketInput; no expected-answer fields are model inputs. Each case used a fresh analysis and Resolve; no pipeline cache hits or retries. Cases ran at concurrency two after the first case; model loading excluded. Local ignored raw outputs are under artifacts/triage/smoke-20260925.
checked_invariants: Every case retained 50 unique candidate documents and original ranks 1–50 through filtering.
Every returned priority matched the pinned matrix for its cited dimensions; absent dimensions kept priority unknown.
Materialized priority quotations matched the original current-fact text.
Each proposed historical contributor had an active reference/conditional comment in the supported service and matching original row provenance.
All assignees remained null, with assignment_authorized=false.
The failed Filter case withheld routing and gave current-fact diagnostic actions only.
Each case used exactly three provider calls; triage and handoff added no inference calls.

validation_errors: Primary G10 does not match the supported service

cases.observation: Filter validation rejected a primary group outside the supported service. All 50 candidates remained available, routing withheld team/contributors, and Resolve returned current-fact diagnostics only. Urgency and priority were unknown. This is a recorded failure, not a successful filter result.

The vague margin-sweep request suggested Treasury & Cash but left impact and priority unknown. Urgency was High based on ASAP/quickly wording; this interpretation is weakly supported and needs analyst review rather than an accuracy claim. No applicable historical contributor was proposed.

The model cited the manual workaround and repeated escalations for High urgency, classified partial critical-service degradation as Significant / Large impact, and the matrix returned High. It did not claim a complete outage. Whether the workaround warrants High versus Medium urgency is not resolved by this smoke.

A standard approved CRM access request produced Low priority and the historical Client Services mapping. Resolve asked for the target identity and retained the already-recorded approval. No historical contributor was fabricated.

The misleading production-outage title was outweighed by explicit no-disruption statements. Low urgency plus No direct impact / Information gave Lowest priority. The historical team was Enterprise Applications; one author was linked only through active reference evidence.

A settlement acknowledgement backlog produced High priority and Securities Operations. One historical contributor was sourced from active settlement comments. Listener restart/replay remained conditional on checking for a stalled consumer, with no assignment or execution.

limitations: Development smoke, not held-out or GT accuracy; no claim of priority/routing improvement over a baseline.
One of six Filter responses failed semantic validation. It was not retried or replaced in this report.
Citation existence and matrix consistency do not establish correct urgency/impact interpretation. Cases 7 and 13 show judgments needing review.
Historical service/team mapping and comment authors do not prove current ownership, availability or permission to act.
Timing is for the full Clean/FAISS/Filter/Resolve workflow and excludes encoder initialization; six cases do not establish production latency. Browser copy/export is verified separately by tests.
The priority policy is pinned challenge guidance, not verified current production policy.

browser_replay.input: Recorded real provider output replayed through the frontend API routes; no additional inference.
checks: Priority/routing and expanded provenance visually inspected.
Markdown downloaded with selected action, manual outcome, source ranks and all-50 candidate count.
browser_replay.analyst_data: Action selection and outcome text are synthetic UI test input, not actual operational work.
